newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid clashes leave 14 police injured,16 arrested.
newsitem.headline: Madrid clashes leave 14 police injured,16 arrested.

text.p: Clashes at an illegal anti-fascist demonstration in central Madrid injured 14 policemen and led to 16 arrests, Spanish police said on Saturday.
Police said about 200 people blocked several streets, set fire to barricades and threw petrol bombs, stones and bottles at police officers after the demonstration on Friday night.
A savings bank was badly damaged and a number of shops, telephone boxes and cars were also hit.
